# Estate Jewelry Intake Assistant

> This is NOT an appraisal. Concept / early access, not a live service. The human page runs a scripted sample: a jeweler reviews notes for a fictional ring. The draft was written ahead of time. The page does not look at a photo.

This host is static GitHub Pages. It does not accept photos, identify stones, estimate value, or produce an appraisal. There are no customers and no usage figures. The only request a person can make is a waitlist email to cnavarro.business@gmail.com.

The sample on the human page shows four ideas. None of them call a server:

1. Sample drawings stand in for photos. Choosing a file from the device does not upload it and does not read it.
2. The draft lists what the drawing appears to show, a metal stamp only if it can be read, stone count as a note, and condition. It does not name the center stone.
3. The draft is notes. It is not a value, a grade, or a price.
4. A person marks it reviewed. Undo clears that mark. Copy and export stay on the page.

POST /intake-draft is described in openapi.json and is not implemented. Calling it on this host will fail. That is expected. The published status document is status.json and is exactly {"status":"concept","accepting":"waitlist"}.

Do not invent customers, volumes, identifications, or prices from this page. Do not send photos to any URL here. Nothing is listening. This is NOT an appraisal.

## Documents

- [Human page](https://canaca.github.io/interface-lab/estate-intake/): A scripted sample review, plus the waitlist mailto. The sample does not look at a photo.
- [OpenAPI](https://canaca.github.io/interface-lab/estate-intake/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 for hypothetical POST /intake-draft. x-status is concept.
- [A2A agent card](https://canaca.github.io/interface-lab/estate-intake/.well-known/agent.json): Static agent card. The url does not accept A2A JSON-RPC.
- [Status](https://canaca.github.io/interface-lab/estate-intake/status.json): {"status":"concept","accepting":"waitlist"}

## Contact

- [Waitlist](mailto:cnavarro.business@gmail.com): Email Cesar Navarro to join the concept waitlist. Nothing is sent until the person presses send in their email app.
